title: Smoked Salmon Sushi Rice Bowl
description: A twist on traditional sushi, featuring smoked salmon and a flavorful Japanese-inspired pilaf. Enjoy as a main dish or as a side.
instructions: Cook the rice pilaf according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add diced potatoes and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add sliced smoked salmon and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to flake.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar.
Pour the sauce over the salmon and potatoes, and toss to coat.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of cooked rice pilaf in a bowl, followed by a spoonful of the salmon and potato mixture.
Garnish with a piece of lightly smoked salmon fillet.
